name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Clause R3 hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) is not mentioned in the task wording. The task only says “If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box,” which does not impose an explicit order that the key must be taken before the box is picked up. Therefore this Precedence clause is an added requirement and must be removed. Clause R4 hard Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) is also not stated in the task. The sentence never says that moving the ball obligates picking up the box later; the box is a separate unconditional goal. Hence this Response clause is an extra, unnecessary rule and must be removed as well. After removing these two clauses, the remaining clauses (RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) and Existence(target_picked_up)) correctly capture the task.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) hard is not stated in the task. The task only says “If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.” It does not require the key to be taken before the box, so this Precedence clause adds an unwarranted ordering requirement and must be removed. Likewise, the clause Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) hard is not expressed in the wording; moving the ball does not impose a rule that the box must eventually be picked up. This extra rule must also be removed. The remaining clauses RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard and Existence(target_picked_up) hard correctly capture the task.
